stories.title: Melania Trump Plays Key Role In Ceasefire To Evacuate Elderly From War Zone
stories.summary: The White House says Melania Trump helped secure a localised ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine in Russian-occupied Oleshky. Al Jazeera, BBC, Daily Wire and Washington Times report that the pause is intended to allow humanitarian aid into the city and civilians to evacuate, with Daily Wire saying it is set to begin on October 29. Russia and Ukraine have confirmed the arrangement, although Al Jazeera says its timing was still being determined.

stories.summary: The Guardian's review describes Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 as a spectacle-heavy return to the series, ranging from rooftop parkour in Manhattan and car chases in Paris to a climactic battle at a North Korean air base. Available on PC, PS5, Switch 2 and Xbox, the game again draws on newspaper-style plots involving terrorist organisations, rogue states and elite soldiers.

stories.title: Opposition deepfake video sparks outrage in Spain ahead of election
stories.summary: A political advertisement from Spain's main opposition party has prompted outrage after using AI-generated likenesses of people linked to Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez's Socialist party, including his wife, to depict admissions of wrongdoing. The Guardian reports that the deepfake has intensified debate over AI as Spain prepares for a general election next month.

stories.title: Apple Watch Ultra 4 review: longer battery life but still awaiting new features
